text: $2.63 billion raised through government bond auctions in October

The Hanoi Stock Exchange (HNX) conducted 20 government bond auctions in October 2026 on behalf of the State Treasury, raising VND69.362 trillion ($2.63 billion), equivalent to 173% of the issuance target for the month.
The State Treasury raised a cumulative VND368.4225 trillion ($14 billion) from the beginning of the year to the end of October through government bond auctions , fulfilling 92% of its full-year plan.
Issuance was concentrated mainly in five-year and 10-year maturities, which accounted for 50.9% and 48.3% of the total volume, respectively.
During October, the State Treasury offered bonds with five maturities: three, five, 10, 15 and 30 years.
Successful bids were recorded for the three-year, five-year and 10-year tenors.
At the final auction of the month, the winning yields for these maturities stood at 3.55%, 4.27% and 4.43% per year, respectively.
